independence_evidence: Terms page: 'This website is operated by Notion London Limited'; the about page describes an independent media group based in London and Los Angeles with its own agency arm (Studio NOTION), not part of any large publishing group.
qualifies_reason: Independently owned London music-and-culture title whose 100th print issue went on sale in late October / November 2026, following two print editions in 2025.
what_it_is: A music and popular-culture magazine built around cover interviews and fashion-led photo shoots with musicians, actors, athletes and internet personalities, each print edition appearing with many different covers. Between numbered issues it publishes 'The Artists' print volumes profiling emerging acts. It is for readers who follow new music, youth culture and celebrity style.
